column1: # --- BigDecimal sign and scale at the edges ------------------------------
# A bigint has no -0, so `-0.0` lost its sign the moment the significand
# was built, and a zero significand short-circuited its exponent away.
# Decimal now carries an explicit negZero flag beside the coefficient, as
# apd carries Negative, and a zero grows its trailing-zero run like any
# other value: the scale is part of the identity, not noise.
